component.name: URPM
component.summary: See every package installed on your computer

description.p: URPM is a cute, friendly window into every package on your Linux machine. It gathers what you have installed from your distro's package manager, Flatpak, Snap, AppImages, Homebrew, Nix, pip, pipx, npm and Cargo into one searchable list.

ul.li: See what's installed, how big it is and when it changed
Filter to only the things you installed yourself
Check for updates across every package manager at once
Open, update or safely remove packages, with a preview of what else would go
Free disk space: unused packages, old versions and caches, previewed first
Find apps installed more than once through different package managers
Export your package list to CSV, JSON or text

description.p: Reach more people: move your apps to a new computer, a command-line companion (urpm list, dupes, clean, backup…), Flatpak permissions in plain words, and translations into Arabic, German, Spanish, French and Brazilian Portuguese. "Just mine" now leaves out what the installer put on the system.

Stay up to date: a History page showing everything installed, updated or removed, security updates highlighted in red, "Keep this version" to hold a package, and an optional background check that notifies you about new updates.

The whole picture: a Cleanup centre that finds unused packages, old versions and caches to free disk space, a Duplicate finder for apps installed more than once, "Needed by" for every package, and real app icons.
Sorting is up to 6 times faster on big systems, and Cargo, pipx and Nix packages now get update checks.

Security and reliability release: safer administrator commands, a warning before opening downloaded AppImages, a Cancel button for running commands, and packages that appear as soon as each package manager is ready.
Two new themes: Matcha (calm sage green) and Aurora (deep navy with teal).
New Settings window with themes: Cotton Candy, Midnight and the new black-and-yellow Gotham theme.
Update all at once, faster search, natural version sorting, compact layouts for small screens, double-click to open.
